name: Virag Super-Real UGC Creative Library
principles: Authentic creator realism outranks studio polish.
Current-turn identity and product fidelity are immutable.
Human anatomy, hands, grip, gaze, contact, lighting and environment must survive close inspection.
Typography is short, exact, phone-readable and native to the scene.
No fake social proof, invented claims or platform interface.
Every variation is structurally different and delivered separately.

commands.label: Natural UGC Creative
commands.desc: Premium authentic creator-style product post.
commands.instruction: Create one natural creator-style product moment with believable human behavior, phone-native framing and a short supplied hook. Keep the setting lived-in and the product interaction unforced.

commands.label: Selfie Product Story
commands.desc: Realistic arm-length selfie with product.
commands.instruction: Use a believable arm-length selfie perspective, natural expression and realistic product grip. Keep the face unobstructed and do not invent spoken testimony.

commands.label: Product in Hand
commands.desc: Natural hand-held product moment.
commands.instruction: Make the hand-product relationship the visual anchor with correct fingers, grip, occlusion and contact shadows. Use a real everyday background and restrained caption copy.

commands.label: First-Person POV
commands.desc: Hands and product from the creator’s viewpoint.
commands.instruction: Use a first-person view with anatomically correct hands performing a plausible action. Keep the product readable and the surface/context truthful rather than staged.

commands.label: Unboxing Moment
commands.desc: Believable package opening and first look.
commands.instruction: Show a realistic current-turn package opening with correct hand mechanics, packaging materials and contents only when supplied. Do not invent accessories, inserts or reactions.

commands.label: Daily Routine
commands.desc: Product integrated into a real routine.
commands.instruction: Place the product naturally inside one believable daily step in a home, gym, kitchen or work context appropriate to the brief. Avoid presenting it like a studio hero shot.

commands.label: Problem → Solution UGC
commands.desc: Supplied problem and solution in one authentic moment.
commands.instruction: Use only the exact supplied problem and solution. Build a credible human situation and concise hook; never fabricate symptoms, benefits, performance or transformation.

commands.label: Supplied Testimonial
commands.desc: Creator testimonial using exact provided words.
commands.instruction: Use the exact current-turn testimonial and supplied person identity only. If no testimonial is supplied, omit testimonial language and create a neutral product-in-use hook.

commands.label: Supplied Review Creative
commands.desc: Review-style UGC using verified supplied copy.
commands.instruction: Use only the exact supplied review, rating and reviewer details. Never invent stars, usernames, quotes or social proof; omit any element not provided.

commands.label: Creator Recommendation
commands.desc: Authentic creator recommendation when authorized.
commands.instruction: Present a natural recommendation only when exact endorsement copy or authorization is supplied. Otherwise create a neutral personal-use moment without endorsement claims.

commands.label: Lived-In Home UGC
commands.desc: Natural product moment in a believable home.
commands.instruction: Use a realistic lived-in home with ordinary objects, coherent daylight and small imperfections. Avoid luxury showroom staging and generic perfect interiors.

commands.label: Real Gym Moment
commands.desc: Authentic gym-use content without fitness clichés.
commands.instruction: Use a believable training environment, natural exertion and correct equipment interaction only when appropriate. Avoid fake sweat, bodybuilding poses and invented performance claims.

commands.label: Kitchen Counter UGC
commands.desc: Realistic kitchen or food-use creator frame.
commands.instruction: Use a believable kitchen or dining context with truthful ingredients and handling only when supplied. Preserve food/product appearance and avoid immaculate set styling.

commands.label: Workday UGC
commands.desc: Natural desk or workplace creator content.
commands.instruction: Integrate the product into a plausible workday moment with realistic desk clutter, posture and practical lighting. Do not imply productivity claims unless supplied.

commands.label: Outdoor Everyday UGC
commands.desc: Candid outdoor product-use moment.
commands.instruction: Use real daylight, grounded shadows, believable clothing movement and an unstaged environment. Keep the product interaction practical rather than hero-posed.

commands.label: Mirror Check UGC
commands.desc: Natural mirror moment with accurate reflections.
commands.instruction: Create an off-centre mirror capture with correct phone, body and product reflections. Avoid impossible reflection geometry, face changes and fashion-editorial polish.

commands.label: Countertop Detail UGC
commands.desc: Close everyday product detail with human presence.
commands.instruction: Use a lived-in surface, partial hand or body cue and truthful material texture. Keep contextual objects few and relevant; no decorative prop pile.

commands.label: Supplied Offer UGC
commands.desc: Native offer creative using exact supplied details.
commands.instruction: Use only the supplied price, discount, dates and CTA in a restrained creator-style overlay. Never invent urgency, savings, coupon codes or availability.

commands.label: FAQ UGC
commands.desc: Creator-style answer using supplied facts.
commands.instruction: Build one question-and-answer frame from exact supplied facts. Keep the answer brief and readable; never fill missing information with assumptions.

commands.label: Verified Before / After
commands.desc: Evidence-based comparison only when both sources exist.
commands.instruction: Use a before/after comparison only when both genuine source images and exact context are supplied. Do not fabricate transformation, alter bodies or create a split-screen board unless explicitly requested; otherwise use a neutral progress-free routine moment.

globalRules: Create super-real creator content that looks captured by a real person in a believable moment, never an AI influencer or cinematic studio advertisement.
Use only the current-turn brief, current-turn people and current-turn product assets.

When a person reference is supplied, preserve exact identity, facial proportions, skin tone, body proportions, hair, clothing and distinguishing details with no beautification or generic face replacement.
Render anatomically correct eyes, teeth, limbs and natural five-finger hands with realistic grip, pressure, occlusion and contact shadows.
Preserve the uploaded product as an immutable pixel source: no redraw, regeneration, relighting, recoloring, warping, label change or invented geometry.
Never invent reviews, testimonials, star ratings, handles, follower counts, verified badges, before/after results, prices, offers, benefits, certifications or endorsements.
Use believable phone-native perspective, natural exposure and white balance, slight human framing imperfection, restrained sensor grain and realistic focus falloff.
Reject plastic skin, waxy faces, beauty filters, fake bokeh, excessive sharpening, haze, cinematic color grading, impossible anatomy and generic AI environments.
Use short exact caption-style 2D typography, maximum two professional font families and three weights; no fake social-platform interface.
Every output is a separate standalone image, never a collage, contact sheet, carousel board, split screen or multi-panel result.
